Sandbox_GettingOld_RandomStartingAge_too: Give newly created characters a random starting age from 25 to 34. Disable this to use the exact Starting Age value instead. Any Getting Old age trait overrides both options.
Sandbox_GettingOld_StartingAge_tooltip: Sets a newly created character's exact starting age when Random Starting Age is disabled. Any Getting Old age trait overrides this value.
Sandbox_GettingOld_RandomBirthday_toolti: Give each newly created character a random birthday. When disabled, each player chooses their own birth month and day after character creation.
Sandbox_GettingOld_YearLengthDays_toolti: How many in-game days equal one year.
Sandbox_GettingOld_DeadlyAge_tooltip: The age at which characters are marked for death from old age. Set this to 0 to disable death from old age.
Sandbox_GettingOld_YearsUntilDeath_toolt: About how many in-game years a character's health takes to decline from full to zero after being marked for death. Each character's duration varies randomly by up to 10 percent.
Sandbox_GettingOld_DeadlyAgeHeartAttacks: Allow characters at or above the Deadly Age to suffer a fatal heart attack while extremely stressed or panicked. The risk rises sharply with age and danger. Disable Deadly Age by setting it to 0.
Sandbox_GettingOld_EnableBirthdayHats_to: Allow players to sometimes receive a birthday hat when they age up.
